name: Wall of Wood (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School conjuration (creation) [wood]; Level druid 4, ranger 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 3, unchained summoner 4, witch 4

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (a small block of wood)

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Effect wooden wall whose area is up to one 5-ft. square/level (S)

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance no

Wood: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate plant or wood in some manner or conjure creatures with the plant subtype or composed of wood. Such spells are considered to belong to the Wood element (for geomancers) and the Wood elemental school (for wood elementalists).

This spell creates a wall of wood that merges into adjoining wooden surfaces. A wall of wood is 1 inch thick per four caster levels and composed of up to one 5-foot square per level. You can double the wall’s area by halving its thickness. The wall cannot be conjured so that it occupies the same space as a creature or another object.

Like wall of stone, you can create a wall of wood in almost any shape you desire. The wall created need not be vertical, nor rest upon any firm foundation as long as it is merged with existing wood. Otherwise, it must be supported. For example, it can be used to bridge a chasm, for instance, or as a ramp, so long as there are sturdy enough surfaces on either end of the wall of wood. For this use, if the span is more than 20 feet, the wall must be arched and buttressed. This requirement reduces the spell’s area by half. The wall can be crudely shaped to allow crenelations, battlements, and so forth by likewise reducing the area.

Like any other wood wall, this one can be destroyed by a disintegrate spell or by normal means such as breaking or burning. Each 5-foot square of the wall has hardness 5 and 10 hit points per inch of thickness. A section of wall whose hit points drop to 0 is breached.

If a creature tries to break through the wall with a single attack, the DC for the Strength check is 15 + 1 per inch of thickness.

It is possible, but difficult, to trap mobile opponents within or under a wall of wood, provided the wall is shaped so it can hold the creatures. Creatures can avoid entrapment with successful Reflex saves.

Breath of Life: The Geomancer, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC; Authors: Connor Bates, Norman Mitchell Jr., and Paulo César Viola Da Silva Maia.
